name: Paddle
desc: Manage customers, subscriptions, and recurring billing with Paddle Billing.

actions.name: list-customers
actions.description: Lists customers from your Paddle account.

actions.name: get-subscription
actions.description: Retrieves a Paddle subscription by ID.

actions.name: update-subscription
actions.description: Updates a Paddle subscription. Send the full recurring item list you want the subscription to keep.

actions.name: cancel-subscription
actions.description: Cancels a Paddle subscription immediately or at the next billing period.

actions.name: create-transaction
actions.description: Creates a Paddle transaction. When you use recurring prices, completing the transaction starts the subscription.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: newActiveSubscription
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription activates — a trial converts or the first payment succeeds.

triggers.name: subscriptionCanceled
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription is canceled — revoke access or notify support.

triggers.name: subscriptionPastDue
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription goes past due — start dunning flows or restrict features.

triggers.name: transactionCompleted
triggers.description: Triggers when a transaction completes successfully — send a receipt or update records.

triggers.name: paymentFailed
triggers.description: Triggers when a transaction payment fails — trigger retry logic or alert the customer.
